prompts.scene: Create ONE landscape 16:9 children's storybook illustration, suitable as a context scene for a 4-year-old Chinese child's reasoning game. Warm soft colored pencil and watercolor, clean friendly shapes, muted cream and sage room, no text, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no arrows, no panels. Medium-wide view: a small East Asian child with short dark hair, coral orange t-shirt, sits at a low pale wooden table. Child looks thirsty, mouth slightly parted, one hand gently touching throat, other hand resting in lap, NOT holding or reaching for anything. On the table within easy reach but separate from the child's hands are exactly one visibly EMPTY transparent tumbler with blue rim and exactly one small clear round water pitcher half full of cool drinking water, standing upright. Show cup's interior/bottom clearly EMPTY, pitcher water level clearly visible. Emphasize clear readable child expression and cup/pitcher silhouettes. Nothing being poured; no drinking yet. Calm sunny home corner, minimal background (small soft curtain and single plant), no sink, no food, no stove, no kettle, no steam, no decorative clutter. Child, cup and pitcher occupy center 75% of image so full scene remains readable at 600px. Full-bleed illustration with no borders. Intended runtime image 1200x675.
prompts.cards: Create ONE square 2x2 educational story-card sheet, four equally sized square panels edge to edge, exact grid at 50% width and height, no gutters, no text, no symbols, no numbers, no arrows. Each panel self contained with generous cream margins keeping all content inside its quadrant so panels can be cropped. Match the attached reference's warm watercolor colored pencil style, SAME short dark-haired East Asian child with coral orange t-shirt, SAME blue-rimmed clear tumbler and small clear pitcher. Simplify backgrounds to warm ivory, table only. Upper left panel: child is thirsty, empty hands, fingertips on throat, mouth parted, one EMPTY cup standing on table, upright half-full pitcher separate. Upper right panel: child clearly TAKES THE EMPTY CUP, hand wrapped around cup near table height, child examining it, cup visibly EMPTY transparent bottom, upright half-full pitcher stays on table. Lower left panel: child carefully POURS cool water from tilted small pitcher, one hand holding pitcher handle and another supporting pitcher, continuous visible stream entering cup standing stably on table, cup partially filled, child looking at cup, NOT drinking. Lower right panel: child DRINKS water, holding tumbler with both hands, cup rim touches lips, cup modestly tilted, eyes relaxed, pitcher stands on table, no stream from pitcher. Each child's head and upper body fills 65% of panel. Natural hands with no extra fingers, exactly one cup and one pitcher per panel. Distinguish each action unmistakably. No food, no sink, no steam. Production story atlas for preschool game.
